label: Voter registration deadline
detail: Last day to register for the Nov 3 General Election, 11:59 p.m.

label: Early voting begins; early ballots mailed
detail: Maricopa Vote Centers begin opening 27 days before Election Day.

label: Last day to request a ballot by mail
detail: Maricopa County lists Oct 23 as the last day to request a replacement ballot by mail.

label: Recommended last day to mail back your ballot
detail: Clean Elections and Maricopa County list Oct 27 as the mail-back date; after that, drop off in person.

label: Last day to vote early in person
Emergency voting window opens (5 p.m. Fri) through 5 p.m. Mon Nov 2
detail: Requires signing an affidavit that an emergency prevents voting on Election Day; the emergency need not be disclosed.

label: Election Day
detail: Polls open 6 a.m. to 7 p.m. Early ballots must be received by 7 p.m.

label: Signature cure deadline, 5:00 p.m.
detail: If the county questions your early-ballot signature, you must verify it by 5:00 p.m. Nov 8 (Maricopa County Recorder).

label: First day for counties to canvass returns
Deadline for Boards of Supervisors to canvass
